busy.title: Already processing

network.body: Check your connection and try again.

disk_full.title: Not enough disk space
disk_full.body: Free some space and try again.

model_corrupt.title: Model file is damaged

model_not_ready.title: Model not downloaded
model_not_ready.body: Download this quality mode before processing.

model_unknown.title: Unknown model
model_unknown.body: Pick a quality mode from the list.

oom.title: Out of memory
oom.body: Try a smaller image or switch to CPU in Settings.

gpu.title: GPU problem

image_unreadable.title: Couldn’t read that image
image_unreadable.body: Try another file (PNG, JPG, WEBP, or BMP).

inference_failed.title: Processing failed
inference_failed.body: Try again. If it keeps failing, switch quality mode or EP.

fallback.title: Finished on CPU
fallback.body: GPU ran out of memory ({{from}} → {{to}}). Settings still use your GPU for next runs.

firstRunGpu.title: Couldn't finish GPU setup
firstRunGpu.body: Using CPU. You can re-run the benchmark in Settings.

modelsUnavailable.title: Couldn't load model list
modelsUnavailable.body: Download a quality mode after the list loads. Try restarting the app.

downloadCancelUnconfirmed.title: Couldn't confirm cancel
downloadCancelUnconfirmed.body: The download may still finish in the background.

revealFailed.title: Couldn't show file in folder
revealFailed.body: Check that the output path still exists.

updateAvailable.title: Update {{version}} available
updateAvailable.body: Open Settings to install and restart.

upToDate.title: You're up to date
upToDate.body: No newer stable release was found.

updateCheckFailed.body: Check your connection and try again.

updateInstallFailed.body: Try again, or download the installer from GitHub Releases.

updateUnavailable.body: Updates are only available in the desktop app.

noImagesInFolder.title: No images in this folder
noImagesInFolder.body: Only top-level PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP are scanned (subfolders are ignored).

dropEither.title: Drop either images or one folder
dropEither.bodyMixed: Mixed drops and multi-folder drops are not supported.

noImagesDropped.title: No images dropped
noImagesDropped.body: Drop PNG, JPG, WEBP, or BMP files, or one folder.

queue.leaveLive: Leave the queue? Pending work will be cancelled and the queue cleared.
